rows.ja: サプライヤー(クラウド基盤)

relations.text: AppianはAmazon Web Servicesと、最低購入コミットメント条項付きの解約不能なクラウドホスティング契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Appian has a non-cancellable cloud hosting arrangement with Amazon Web Services that contains provisions for minimum purchase commitments

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We have a non-cancellable cloud hosting arrangement with Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) that contains provisions for minimum purchase commitments.

relations.text: Appianの戦略的パートナーの1社で、顧客にAppianのソフトウェア購入を紹介できる
relations.text_en: A strategic partner of Appian that can refer customers to it to purchase software subscriptions

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We also have several strategic partnerships, including with Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte, Indra Group, KPMG, and PwC, which allow them to refer customers to us in order to purchase software subscriptions.

relations.text: 年次報告が、Accentureとの戦略的パートナーシップを挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists a strategic partnership with Accenture

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We have a number of strategic partnerships with companies, including Accenture, Capgemini, Deloitte, Indra Group, KPMG, and PwC.

relations.text: Appianのクレジット契約(2023年6月13日付の第3次修正)の当事者にWells Fargo Bank, National Associationが含まれる
relations.text_en: Wells Fargo Bank, National Association is a party to Appian's Third Amendment to Credit Agreement dated June 13, 2023

source.quote: 10.30 Third Amendment to Credit Agreement, dated as of June 13, 2023, by and among Appian Corporation, MUFG Bank, Ltd., Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, Comerica Bank, Customers Bank, and Silicon Valley Bank, a division of First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company (successor by purchase to the
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同クレジット契約の2023年2月21日付の併合および第2次修正にも当事者として含まれる
relations.text_en: It is also a party to the Joinder and Second Amendment to Credit Agreement dated February 21, 2023

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: 10.29 Joinder and Second Amendment to Credit Agreement, dated as of February 21, 2023, by and among Appian Corporation, MUFG Bank, Ltd., Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, Comerica Bank, Customers Bank, and Silicon Valley Bank.

relations.text: アピアンの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in アピアン’s annual report

source.label: Appian 10-K
source.quote: We have obtained a judgment preservation insurance policy with respect to a now-vacated judgment and ongoing litigation against our competitor, Pegasystems, and both the payment on the policy and continued litigation are subject to risks and costs.
